title: Language Models are Alignable Decision-Makers: Dataset and Application to the Medical Triage Domain

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating language models on a custom medical triage dataset labeled with decision-maker attributes (DMAs) such as utilitarianism, moral desert, risk aversion, protocol focus, and continuing care to measure implicit moral tendencies and alignment accuracy.

Measuring model alignment to the 'Fairness' attribute in medical triage scenarios, evaluating if decisions prioritize individuals based on group membership, personal relationships, identity, or social status.
